entries: {DISASTER:strikes} hit {place}, and {first} saw home in a new light.
{first} came across {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, and discovered what {CLOSE:human} had kept back.
{MESSAGE:physical} from {SOMEONE:human,!plural} said: be at {landmark}, and be alone.
{SOMEONE:human,!plural} gave {first} {THING:portable} at {landmark} {MANNER}, and nothing was quite the same.
The {rival} humiliated {SOMEONE:human,!plural} in public, and {first} spoke up.
{SOMEONE:!plural} rolled into {place} {MANNER} and rearranged the whole summer.
